name: Mailgun
desc: Email delivery service for sending, receiving, and tracking emails

actions.name: send_email
actions.description: Send an email using your Mailgun domain

actions.name: validate_email
actions.description: Validate an email address using Mailgun validation service. Requires a Mailgun account with email validation enabled.

actions.name: add_mailing_list_member
actions.description: Add a new member to a Mailgun mailing list

actions.name: get_events
actions.description: Retrieve email events from your Mailgun domain (deliveries, failures, opens, clicks, etc.). Useful for monitoring and alerting.

actions.name: get_domain_stats
actions.description: Retrieve aggregated email statistics for a Mailgun domain (delivered, failed, opened, etc.). Useful for monitoring delivery health and detecting anomalies.

actions.name: list_bounces
actions.description: Retrieve the list of bounced email addresses for a Mailgun domain. Useful for cleanup after delivery issues or spam attacks.

actions.name: delete_bounces_bulk
actions.description: Remove bounced addresses from the Mailgun suppression list, either all at once for a domain or a single address.

actions.name: get_domain_health
actions.description: Fetch the health of a Mailgun domain: current state, whether it has been disabled, and DNS verification status for sending and receiving records.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_bounce_event
triggers.description: Triggers when an email permanently fails to deliver (hard bounce) in Mailgun

triggers.name: new_complaint_event
triggers.description: Triggers when a recipient reports an email as spam in Mailgun

triggers.name: new_delivery_event
triggers.description: Triggers when an email is successfully delivered in Mailgun

triggers.name: new_failed_delivery_event
triggers.description: Triggers when an email temporarily fails to deliver in Mailgun (will be retried)

triggers.name: new_open_event
triggers.description: Triggers when a recipient opens an email in Mailgun

triggers.name: new_click_event
triggers.description: Triggers when a recipient clicks a tracked link in an email in Mailgun

triggers.name: new_unsubscribe_event
triggers.description: Triggers when a recipient unsubscribes from emails in Mailgun

triggers.name: bulk_bounce_threshold_exceeded
triggers.description: Triggers once when too many emails bounce within a set time period. Useful for catching spam attacks or deliverability problems early.

guides.excerpt: HubSpot alternatives provide scalable options for teams looking to reduce software expenses while maintaining essential sales and marketing workflows.
